summary.name: Case Study: Adopting SRE Principles at StackOverflow
summary.one_liner: A 2015 SREcon talk by Tom Limoncelli describing the author's experience adopting Site Reliability Engineering practices at Stack Exchange (StackOverflow.com and ServerFault.com).
keywords: the practice of cloud system administration
use_cases: Learning how to introduce SRE practices at a non-large company
Reviewing lessons learned from a real SRE adoption
Finding monitoring tools such as Boson
Educating a team about SRE ways using book sections
Studying operations culture at Stack Exchange
summary.what_it_does: The page is the listing for a conference talk given at SREcon15 in Santa Clara, CA. The speaker, Tom Limoncelli of Stack Exchange, reviews the company's attempts to adopt SRE principles, covering both successes and failures. The talk describes publicly available tools, including the monitoring solution Boson, and techniques suited to smaller companies. It also points to sections of the author's book, The Practice of Cloud System Administration, that can be used to teach others about SRE. The page gives no slides or video links in the text shown.
notable: Covers failures as well as successes of SRE adoption at Stack Exchange
Mentions the Boson monitoring solution and other public tools
Ties to the book The Practice of Cloud System Administration
Focused on adopting SRE outside large 'unicorn' companies
caveats: Describes a 2015 talk; tools and practices may be outdated
Page is a conference session listing, not a standalone tool; the talk's slides or recording are not shown in the page text
Registration for the original conference was $400 (listed on the page)
